functions.fleur_print_header:
void fleur_print_header(header *h)
{
    printf("Header details:
 version: %lu
 n: %lu 
 p: %f
 k: %lu 
 m: %lu 
 N: %lu 
", h->version, h->n, h->p,
           h->k, h->m, h->N);
}
functions.fleur_print_filter:
void fleur_print_filter(BloomFilter *bf)
{
    printf("Filter details:
 n: %lu 
 p: %f
 k: %lu 
 m: %lu 
 N: %lu 
 M: %lu
 Data: %s.
", bf->h.n, bf->h.p,
           bf->h.k, bf->h.m, bf->h.N, bf->M, bf->Data);
}
